annotation.title_clean: AI Nation 2030: National AI Action Plan 2026-2030
annotation.title_en: AI Nation 2030: National AI Action Plan 2026-2030
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Malaysia; AI Malaysia (National AI Office)
annotation.summary_en: Malaysia's national AI action plan for 2026-2030, setting the AI Nation 2030 vision with 14 sectoral Impact Engines and 14 Foundational Enablers covering talent, data, compute and responsible governance. It is mostly an adoption and industrial-policy strategy, with governance proposals such as an AI Trust Function, risk-based frameworks and national AI classification. Physical or embodied AI appears only incidentally.
key_provisions_or_claims: Targets: Top 10 in global AI indices, +1.2 pp GDP growth and 300,000 AI-attributable jobs by 2030
14 sectoral Impact Engines (healthcare, AI cities, public services, manufacturing, plantation, etc.) with Ignite-Scale-Transform phases
Foundational Enablers include holistic and sectoral AI governance, an AI Trust Function and national AI classification/certification
Builds on the National Guidelines on AI Governance and Ethics (AIGE) and its seven principles
Mandatory AI training for civil servants before approving or overseeing government AI systems
